title: I know it’s subjective…
text:
I’ve gotten 4 shirts so far and only sorta like one of the designs (book of boba Fett with boba and fennic) but the other 3 were silly and/or too brightly colored. Gonna give it a couple more months (this months looks like it’s pretty cool)

I know art is subjective and everyone has different tastes in things, so you may love these shirts. Give it a try, you get free returns with prime (if new
and unwashed)
label: neutral
